text:
Diane Lee: Thinking of running a 'High Five Week' during the All-Hands week — quick peer recognition + five micro-spot awards. Starting this thread to nail timeline, budget, and international logistics.

Tom Nguyen: Nice. How many awards and what $ per award? Also timeline? :raised_hands:

Diane Lee: 5 awards at $80 USD each (e-gift or local equivalent). Nominations open Tues -> Thu, winners announced at Friday All-Hands. Need sign-off from Finance for $400 + tax buffer.

Isabel Rivera: Are we doing swag packs for winners too? shipping might be messy for EU/APAC.

Diane Lee: Offer winners a choice: e-gift OR local swag kit. If swag, we'll check customs/vat and procurement. Prefer e-gifts for international recipients to avoid DDP issues.

Samir Kulkarni: Can nominators be anonymous? also can managers nominate direct reports?

Diane Lee: Anonymous ok, managers can nominate but must mark relationship. We want a short impact line (<=30 words).

HR-Bot: Nomination form live: https://forms.gle/highfiveweek2026 (fields: nominee, nominator optional, team, 30-word reason, location, reward preference: e-gift/swack(shipping), shoutout-only)

Molly Grant: Quick ops Q: do winners need to accept gift (tax) or can they opt for charity donation?

Diane Lee: Add charity option and shoutout-only. If they accept gift, we'll collect payment email and country for tax paperwork.

Priya Singh: Finance note: gifts under local thresholds usually fine, but for some countries we need paperwork. Also need a PO for the swag vendor if we order kits. I'll confirm thresholds.

Tom Nguyen: Can I help with the slide design and the All-Hands script? I'll make a short one-liner template per winner.

Isabel Rivera: I'd like to help moderate nominations. Can we add a simple rubric? Keeps reviewers aligned.

Diane Lee: Short rubric in form description: teamwork (1-3), impact (1-3), exemplifying company values (1-3). Reviewers average scores. Ties resolved by panel vote.

HR-Bot: Reminder scheduled: post in #general 2 days before close and morning of close.

Samir Kulkarni: Ops detail: for swag, we should cap "swag kit" to regions where procurement can handle shipping. I'll draft a quick country list.

Priya Singh: Also confirm whether vendor invoices need to be routed through procurement or if finance can handle small one-off purchases.

Molly Grant: I'll make a shared spreadsheet to record finalists, reward choices, emails for payout, and any vendor shipping notes.

Diane Lee: Action list:
- Diane: update form with rubric + charity option (today)
- Priya: confirm tax thresholds + PO requirements with Procurement/Finance (today)
- Samir: compile approved shipping regions for swag (tomorrow)
- Tom: All-Hands slide + script template (after finalists)
- Molly: create payout & logistics sheet (link when ready)
- HR-Bot: reminders per schedule

Isabel Rivera: Small ask: can winners who opt out get a "digital badge" + Slack emoji in the recognition thread? low-friction honor.

Diane Lee: Yes, we'll add a digital badge and a Slack emoji. Good idea.

Priya Singh: I'll draft a short note to Finance/Procurement to pre-approve the $400 + up-to-$100 buffer for shipping/taxes. Post finalists here once chosen and I'll route the payment.

Tom Nguyen: I'll start a Google Slide template and post link here shortly.

Molly Grant: Shared sheet created: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/highfive-payouts (edit access to People Ops).

Diane Lee: Thanks team  closing for now, will reopen if any flags. Please @mention me on any form responses that look HR-sensitive. :tada:
